# ContiExpert by Volt Autocare

> ContiExpert by Volt Autocare is a car workshop inside the Shell station at 143 Bukit Timah Road, Newton Circus, Singapore 229843. It services and repairs European cars (Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Volkswagen) and checks hybrids and EVs. Call or WhatsApp +65 8221 5502. Google Maps: "Volt Autocare @Bukit Timah", 5.0 stars from 22 reviews (checked 3 Nov 2026).

- Website: https://contiexpert.sg/
- Email: Newton@voltauto.sg
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Volt+Autocare+@Bukit+Timah/@1.3109645,103.8421669,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x31da19a1ff4674a3:0x2cd1ca1effa4a97b!8m2!3d1.3109645!4d103.8421669!16s%2Fg%2F11x64r1zbq

## Services
- [European Car Servicing](https://contiexpert.sg/services/european-car-servicing/): Scheduled servicing, oil and filter changes and inspections for Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Volkswagen and other European cars.
- [Car Diagnostics and Warning Lights](https://contiexpert.sg/services/car-diagnostics-warning-lights/): Warning light on? We read the fault codes, test the system and explain what is wrong before any repair is agreed.
- [Car Aircon Repair](https://contiexpert.sg/services/car-aircon-repair/): Aircon blowing warm, smelly or weak? We check for leaks, the compressor and the cooling coil, then explain the fix.
- [Brake and Suspension Repair](https://contiexpert.sg/services/brake-suspension-repair/): Noisy brakes, a soft pedal, knocks over bumps or a car pulling to one side. We inspect, explain and quote first.
- [Gearbox and Transmission Service](https://contiexpert.sg/services/gearbox-transmission-service/): ATF service and gearbox checks for jerky shifts, slipping, delays or warnings. We inspect and explain before any repair.
- [Hybrid and EV Servicing](https://contiexpert.sg/services/hybrid-ev-servicing/): Hybrid and EV checks, including battery state-of-health checks, hybrid battery fan cleaning and pre-purchase inspections.
- [Pre-Purchase Inspection](https://contiexpert.sg/services/pre-purchase-inspection/): Buying a used car? Get it inspected first. Standard and hybrid or EV pre-purchase inspections, with a clear summary of findings.

## Makes
- [Mercedes-Benz](https://contiexpert.sg/brands/mercedes-benz/): Servicing, warning lights, overheating, aircon and gearbox issues on Mercedes-Benz cars, checked and explained before any repair.
- [BMW](https://contiexpert.sg/brands/bmw/): Check engine lights, servicing, aircon faults and gearbox concerns on BMW cars, inspected and explained before any work is agreed.
- [Audi and Volkswagen](https://contiexpert.sg/brands/audi-volkswagen/): Aircon, gearbox, warning light and servicing issues on Audi and Volkswagen cars, inspected and explained before any repair.
